_comment: Moonshot Kimi hosted API (https://platform.moonshot.ai). Before running: (1) confirm the exact model id on the provider dashboard and replace MODEL_ID_PLACEHOLDER below, and pass the same string via --digest so the transcript pins it verbatim; (2) replace the PLACEHOLDER prices with current rates; (3) supply the key from the environment at run time: --api-key "$KIMI_API_KEY". Never put a key in this file.

prices._comment: PLACEHOLDER rates, USD per 1M tokens. Replace with current provider pricing before trusting any cost figure.
